summary: GraphARC checks form the proof basis but omit issuer, dependency digests, freshness, and materializer identity.
Only a trust-separated issuer or gateway rerun can make admission evidence non-forgeable.

decision: Decisions 1 and 7 — Sealed IR and organization/work separation
summary: Proof subject uses full canonical digests and binds every mutable checker dependency.
Gateway verifies admission evidence first, then independently rebinds current authorization facts and commits through existing single-use allow.
Local admission refusal and gateway proof denial remain distinct persistence boundaries.
Proof freshness is dependency-version freshness plus expiry, followed by commit-time head/epoch/fence revalidation.
